Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run build:binary`
- [ ] Tests cover relevant behavior, edge cases, and regressions.
- [ ] User-facing changes include documentation.
- [ ] Fixtures contain invented commands only, with no private shell history.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to flags, output, or supported platforms. The release workflow
selects the version from the generated contract; do not edit version numbers.
